svg.title: capture-check: catch capture stalls in source-frame timestamps
svg.desc: Pixel-art project card for capture-check, an open source preview tool in Python 3.10+ (MIT, no runtime dependencies) that checks source-frame timestamps for slow cadence and capture stalls. A frame timeline replays its stall sample: film frames land every 16.67 ms, then none arrive; a counter of the time since the last frame passes the 33.33 ms max gap limit and turns red, a bug hatches in the gap, and when the late frame lands a bracket cages the gap, 12 red tiles mark the missing 60 fps ticks and an alert reads STALL 216.67 MS. The run spans 10 intervals in 366.67 ms. The readout shows status FAIL, cadence 27.27 fps, p95 216.67 ms, exit code 1 and median 16.67 ms, with a note that the median alone hides the stall. The red-hooded hero stomps the bug and it turns into a coin. Then the steady sample passes: 10 intervals in 166.67 ms, 60.00 fps, exit code 0, no stalls.
